title: Learn about paranormal history at the Ghost Museum
excerpt: The Ghost Museum explores the history of the paranormal through artifacts and historical accounts.

ByAmanda Brady

Friday, October 30, 2026 2:49PM

The Ghost Museum in Berlin, Maryland, explores the history of the paranormal through artifacts and historical accounts.

Berlin, MD -- The Ghost Museum in Berlin, Maryland, explores the history of the paranormal through artifacts and historical accounts. "We offer a good mix of fiction and nonfiction when it comes to explaining if ghosts could be here," explains general manager, Jessica Ader.
The Ghost Museum has been open for a year and a half and wants visitors to know that it is not a haunted house. "You will not be spooked out of your skin if you come," says Alder. "We have a lot of information about the town of Berlin and the ghosts that seem haunt the area, ghosts from pop culture, ghosts throughout history. Trying to give you afull perspective".
The museum is open daily from 1pm-7pm until the end of October. November and December, it is only open on weekends.
